name.ja: Ｂトレインショーティー・国鉄荷物客車
name.en: B Train Shorty/JNR Luggage Passenger Car

description.ja: • 国鉄民営化とともに姿を消した往年の「荷物専用列車」を再現。
description.en: • Recreates the "cargo-only trains" of the past, which disappeared with the privatization of Japanese National Railways.

description.ja: • 荷物客車の多くは、旅客用客車からの改造。幹線を長編成で運行した「荷物専用列車」はさながら走る客車博物館で、鉄道ファンの人気を集めた。
description.en: • Many of the luggage coaches are modified from passenger coaches. The ``cargo trains'' that ran in long formations on main lines were like a museum of passenger cars, and were popular among railway fans.

description.ja: • 国鉄末期に新造された50系客車と同じグループのマニ50、貨車でありながら客車と連結できる荷貨物兼用車のワキ8000を含む６両入り。
description.en: • Contains 6 cars, including the Mani 50, which is the same group as the 50 series passenger cars that were newly built at the end of the JNR era, and the Waki ​​8000, which is a cargo car that can be connected to a passenger car even though it is a freight car.

description.ja: • 10系寝台車や43系客車に連結すれば、急行列車や長距離鈍行列車を楽しめる。
description.en: • If you connect it to a 10 series sleeper car or a 43 series passenger car, you can enjoy express trains and long-distance slow trains.

description.ja: • 牽引する機関車には、EF58・EF64（ベストリピート・パート９）、DF50、EF61（ベストリピート・パート12）などが好適。
description.en: • EF58, EF64 (Best Repeat Part 9), DF50, EF61 (Best Repeat Part 12) are suitable for pulling locomotives.
